# Agent context file

This week's assignment looks at how model settings like temperature can effect results of model generation. For example, how setting a high top-p value can cause your model to expand its vocabulary to the maximum, potentially making responses excessive and grammatically flawed.

## Scope
Utilizes Jupyter notebook files, python
Showcasing different settings for llms and how they effect output
the distilgpt2 model

AI was utilized to make graphs and to help with the generateText function for my discussion post. All analysis is my own and not AI generated.
